rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “involved” means complicated or difficult to follow.

example.english: This procedure is so involved that I can't follow it.
example.traditional: 呢個程序複雜到我睇唔明。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 zeoi6 fuk1 zaap6 dou3 ngo5 tai2 m4 ming4

rows.note: Use this for a person or group that actively participates in doing something.

example.english: I was involved in putting this project together too.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dou1 jau5 fan6 gaau2 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this when someone or something is included in a process, group, or arrangement rather than stressing active participation.

example.english: The breakfast cost is involved in the package price, so there’s no extra charge.
example.traditional: 早餐包括喺優惠入面㗎。
example.jyutping: zou2 caan1 baau1 kut3 hai2 jau1 wai6 jap6 min6 gaa3

rows.note: Use this colloquial construction specifically when “involved” means having an affair with someone.

example.english: I heard he was involved with that girl.
example.traditional: 我聽講佢同嗰個女仔有路。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 gong2 keoi5 tung4 go2 go3 neoi5 zai2 jau5 lou6
